name: First Step Through the Veil
description:
First Step Through the Veil is where the Beyond the Veil path begins: a guided opening for seekers who are no longer looking for information, but embodiment.

It introduces the ground the mentorship is built on — Identity, Purpose, Power, and Transformation — and gives you the first practices to walk it, so that when you are ready to go further, you arrive already in motion.

name: Divine Alignment Blueprint
description:
Your Audit shows the numbers; the Blueprint reveals the story behind them. Using your responses, the Alignment Agent generates a personalised written Blueprint that interprets your four domain scores, identifies root patterns and blockages, and outlines a practical 7-day plan to begin shifting into deeper alignment.

You’ll receive a beautifully structured document you can pray through, journal with, and return to whenever you feel yourself drifting off-course.

name: Deep Dive Call
description:
A focused 30-minute session that goes through your Inner Alignment Audit results in depth. Together you’ll look at all four domains, name the primary lever, and leave with a clear first move for the next seven days.

Best taken alongside the Purpose Activation Toolkit, so the session lands on a plan you’re already working.

name: The Teachings of the Palace of Excellence — Book 12: Legacy and Impact
description:
The series closes where every life eventually points — what remains. Book Twelve turns attention outward and forward: the people you will shape, the work that outlasts you, and the difference between being remembered and being fruitful. You will define the legacy you intend rather than the one you drift into, and take the first concrete steps toward building it now.

Book 12 of the twelve-book Palace of Excellence series by Jeremiah Van Wagner.

name: The Teachings of the Palace of Excellence — Book 11: Purposeful Leadership
description:
Leadership is not position; it is the willingness to go first and carry others. Book Eleven examines influence as stewardship — how character forms before authority arrives, how to build people rather than followings, and how to lead from conviction under pressure. Whether you lead a household, a team, or a movement, the work is the same: serve, and be worth following.

Book 11 of the twelve-book Palace of Excellence series by Jeremiah Van Wagner.

name: The Teachings of the Palace of Excellence — Book 10: Creativity and Innovation
description:
You were made in the image of a Maker, which means creating is native to you. Book Ten reawakens the creative capacity that adulthood tends to file away as impractical. You will work through the fear of making something imperfect, learn to notice and follow original thought, and put creativity to work as an act of service rather than self-display.

Book 10 of the twelve-book Palace of Excellence series by Jeremiah Van Wagner.

name: The Teachings of the Palace of Excellence — Book 9: Spiritual Growth
description:
At the center of the Palace is communion. Book Nine turns to the inner life — prayer, stillness, discernment, and the slow work of becoming someone whose outward life matches an inward reality. You will learn to make room for God's voice in an environment engineered to crowd it out, and to let that relationship, rather than performance, set the pace of your growth.

Book 9 of the twelve-book Palace of Excellence series by Jeremiah Van Wagner.

name: The Teachings of the Palace of Excellence — Book 8: Overcoming Challenges
description:
Difficulty is not evidence that you took a wrong turn. Book Eight is about endurance — how to stay upright when the path narrows, how to grieve honestly, and how resistance becomes formation rather than defeat. You will build a practice for the hard seasons, so that trouble refines what you carry instead of taking it from you.

Book 8 of the twelve-book Palace of Excellence series by Jeremiah Van Wagner.

name: The Teachings of the Palace of Excellence — Book 7: Financial Freedom
description:
Money is a tool and a teacher. Book Seven reframes wealth as capacity — the ability to move, to give, and to say yes to what you are called to without fear setting the terms. You will build practical footing with earning, stewardship, and generosity, and confront the beliefs about provision that quietly decide how you handle every dollar.

Book 7 of the twelve-book Palace of Excellence series by Jeremiah Van Wagner.

name: The Teachings of the Palace of Excellence — Book 6: Career and Purpose
description:
Work is not separate from calling; it is one of the places calling shows up. Book Six helps you close the distance between what you do all day and what you are for. You will examine the gifts you already carry, the work that draws them out, and the honest questions of provision and timing — so that your vocation becomes an expression of purpose rather than a detour around it.

Book 6 of the twelve-book Palace of Excellence series by Jeremiah Van Wagner.

name: The Teachings of the Palace of Excellence — Book 5: Building Meaningful Relationships
description:
We were made for each other, not merely near each other. Book Five explores how trust is built, how honest boundaries protect love rather than limit it, and how to give and receive without losing yourself. You will look at the relationships you are in, the ones you are called to, and the repair work that makes both possible — because people serving others is the whole point.

Book 5 of the twelve-book Palace of Excellence series by Jeremiah Van Wagner.

name: The Teachings of the Palace of Excellence — Book 4: Health and Wellness
description:
You cannot carry a calling in a body you are at war with. Book Four treats health as stewardship rather than vanity — rest, movement, nourishment, and attention as the practical care of the vessel your purpose travels in. You will build sustainable rhythms instead of punishing regimens, and learn to read your body as an instrument that reports honestly on how you are living.

Book 4 of the twelve-book Palace of Excellence series by Jeremiah Van Wagner.

name: The Teachings of the Palace of Excellence — Book 3: Mindset Mastery
description:
The mind is the ground everything else grows in. Book Three examines the beliefs running quietly underneath your decisions and shows you how to test them against truth rather than habit. You will work through the patterns that shape reaction, learn to hold a thought without obeying it, and build the inner steadiness that lets conviction outlast mood. Mastery here is not control — it is agreement between what you believe and how you live.

Book 3 of the twelve-book Palace of Excellence series by Jeremiah Van Wagner.

name: The Teachings of the Palace of Excellence — Book 2: Designing Your Life Plan
description:
Clarity becomes real the moment it takes a shape you can walk. Book Two turns recognition into architecture — a life plan built from your values outward rather than from other people's expectations inward. You will map the seasons ahead, set markers you can actually measure, and build rhythms that survive a hard week. Vision without structure stays a feeling; here it becomes a plan with edges, dates, and a way to know you are on it.

Book 2 of the twelve-book Palace of Excellence series by Jeremiah Van Wagner.

name: The Teachings of the Palace of Excellence — Book 1: Discovering Your Purpose
description:
Purpose is not something you invent — it is something you recognize. Book One opens the series by helping you see the design already written into how you think, feel, and move through the world. Through guided reflection you will trace the difference between the calling on your life and the assignments that carry it, and learn to tell your own voice apart from the noise around it. This is the doorway into the Palace: before you build a life, you learn whose you are and what you were made to carry.

Book 1 of the twelve-book Palace of Excellence series by Jeremiah Van Wagner.

name: Strategic Partnership
description: By invitation only - maximum 3 partners annually. High-level strategic alliance for visionary leaders building 7-8 figure movements. This is co-creation at the highest level: joint ventures, revenue share agreements, retreat co-hosting, program co-development, book/content collaboration, and legacy building support. Includes unlimited strategic access, network capital, joint marketing, and collaborative revenue opportunities. Investment: $25,000-$100,000+ depending on scope. Requires mission alignment and strategic fit.

name: Private Coaching
description: Exclusive 1-on-1 quarterly private coaching limited to 8 clients. Most direct path to $1M purpose-driven business. Includes 13 weekly 90-minute sessions per quarter, unlimited 7-day Voxer access (4-hour response M-F), custom program design, quarterly VIP intensive day, all program access, VIP Mastermind observer status, team training session, and emergency 24-hour support. 6-month minimum. Average client result: $127K revenue increase in year 1.

name: VIP Mastermind
description: Elite quarterly mastermind for purpose-driven leaders scaling to $250K+. Limited to 25 members. Includes 4 full-day quarterly intensives, 12 monthly deep-dive calls, 48 weekly power hours, private community access, 2 private 1-on-1 sessions per quarter, M-F Voxer access, all course access, and annual in-person gathering. 1-year commitment. Average member ROI: 8.4x in year 1.

name: Ascension Intensive
description: 6-week transformation program for purpose-driven leaders ready to quantum leap. Includes 6 group coaching sessions, Divine Blueprint Mapping, shadow integration, embodiment practices, quantum timeline jumping, and 21-day Voxer access. Plus Ascension Playbook, energy transmissions, lifetime recordings, and 30-day VIP Mastermind trial. Payment plan available.

name: Beyond the Veil Mentorship
description:
Beyond the Veil Mentorship is a transformational mentorship experience designed for seekers who are no longer looking for information—but embodiment.

This program guides you beyond surface-level spirituality and into lived alignment by integrating:

  • Consciousness science

  • Spiritual discernment

  • Emotional integration

  • Purpose clarity

  • Structured action

This is not therapy. This is not motivation. This is initiation through understanding, structure, and alignment.

You will learn to:

  • Identify and dissolve internal illusions that distort perception

  • Stabilize your nervous system and inner authority

  • Align thought, word, and action into coherence

  • Discern intuition from emotion, fear, or conditioning

  • Operate from purpose rather than reaction

  • Build an internal framework that sustains clarity long-term

This mentorship combines teaching, reflection, practical tools, and guided integration to help you live aligned—not just understand alignment.

name: Inner-Work Integration Course
description: A focused, self-paced mini-course designed to help you actually do the inner work your Blueprint reveals. Across a series of short teachings, guided exercises, and reflection prompts, you’ll walk through your patterns, dismantle limiting beliefs, and practice new, alignment-building habits. Each lesson connects directly back to your scores and Blueprint insights, so you’re not just consuming content—you’re transforming the way you think, feel, and show up before God.

name: Purpose Activation Toolkit
description:
Clarity isn’t missing. Alignment is.

You do not have a motivation problem; you have a system problem. The Purpose Activation Toolkit is not a workbook to read—it is an operating system to install. It bridges the gap between "knowing" your calling and actually walking in it.

This toolkit replaces emotional guessing with spiritual precision. It provides the exact frameworks needed to discern your design, make decisions from your Higher Self, and translate abstract purpose into a concrete 30-day plan.

What You Are Installing:

  • The Purpose Activation Framework: Distinguish between your macro Calling, your specific Assignments, and your current Season.

  • The 7-Step Divine Decision Matrix: A repeatable process to stop reacting to urgency and start choosing from peace and strategy.

  • The Alignment-to-Action Roadmap: A 30-day execution plan to close the gap between your intentions and your daily reality.

  • Execution Prompts: High-leverage questions to interrupt autopilot and restore focus instantly.

Your Outcome: Stop negotiating with your potential. Move from "wondering" to walking. Build the architecture that makes your purpose inevitable.

name: Inner Alignment Audit
description: A premium self-diagnostic that helps believers locate internal drift, restore clarity, and rebuild alignment—without shame, striving, or spiritual performance. Participants complete a guided audit across four domains, receive clear scoring thresholds, and then integrate their results in a focused follow-up call.
